name: Print Time & Cost
blurb: print time and cost from volume, infill and material price
intro: Estimates an FDM print's filament mass, time and cost from the part volume (and surface area if you have it), the walls, infill and print settings. It is a first-order model (shell + infill, time = volume / effective flow), typically within ±25 % of a slicer.

inputs.label: Surface area
inputs.help: From CAD; empty = estimated as a cube.

inputs.label: Efficiency
inputs.help: Average share of the nominal speed actually reached.

examples.title: PETG enclosure with support, 0.6 mm nozzle

usage: Give the part volume in cm³ (and surface area in cm² if known), material (pla, petg, abs, asa, tpu, pa, pc, cf), filament price per kg, infill %, walls, support % of volume, line width and layer height in mm, speed in mm/s and efficiency %; optionally machine rate per hour, printer power in W, energy price per kWh, failure margin % and a currency label. It returns print time, filament grams and length, material, machine and total cost, and a table for other infills. Use it for a quick quote or to compare settings before slicing.
sources: Rule of thumb: shell + infill volume model and time = extruded volume / (speed x line width x layer height x efficiency), as used by slicer estimates
Filament densities: manufacturers' data sheets (Prusament, Polymaker)
